The FloPlast Hi-Cap external half round gutter stop end in black is specifically engineered to cap off a 115mm round line gutter length, ensuring efficient rainwater drainage system completion. This uPVC stop end features a semi-elliptical profile, delivering a high capacity flow rate that can reduce the number of required outlets and minimise drainage runs. It is suitable for diverse projects, including new builds, house refurbishments, conservatories, and extensions. For secure installation, the fitting requires support from fascia brackets within 150mm. Its robust construction provides a reliable and long-lasting solution for external guttering.
